decisions.reason: Premium support builds directly on the firm's established service and support knowledge, so its absorptive capacity for learning and improving this product is high.
The version management tool extends the firm's existing software and hosting infrastructure, aligning with its internal R&D and technical know-how.
As a legal-contract tool distant from the firm's hosting and technical knowledge, the firm likely lacks the related expertise to interpret results and improve it.
Scalable agency hosting is at the core of the firm's established offer and resources, making it easy to assimilate feedback and refine.
